decisions.reason: The yogurt on mango mousse won the eathealthy Award and was publicly promoted, so the firm has a visible success to defend and strong reason to persist.
The Abendbrotkäse was featured on the home page as a new highlight, a public commitment that management will want to justify by giving it time to build sales.
The semi-hard cheese wheel sits close to the core cheese offer and uses existing organic milk supply and production, so dropping it after one year would be premature.
The spicy cheese got only a low-profile website mention, but it is part of the announced cheese range expansion and weak early results can still be blamed on start-up effects.
The mild creamy soft cheese was explicitly announced as rounding off the new range, which ties it to the firm's stated direction and makes withdrawal hard to justify.
The washed-rind soft cheese is more niche and less visibly promoted, but the investment in the soft-cheese line and the short time on the market favor persisting.
